name: Residencia por Vinculo (Residence by Family Bond)

requirements.blocker_text: DGME's 'Residencia por Vinculo' requires the marriage to a Nicaraguan citizen to have existed for at least 2 years before application. Required documents: application form, motivation letter, passport copy, apostilled birth certificate, police record (home country or INTERPOL), marriage certificate, health certificate, and proof of income. Authorization is valid for 5 years; the fee for employed applicants is USD 610 for the full 5-year period.
requirements.fix_path: Maintain the marriage to a Nicaraguan citizen for at least 2 years, then apply to DGME with the required documentation.

requirement_groups.name: Parent of a child born in Nicaragua

requirements.blocker_text: DGME's 'Residencia por Vinculo' also covers foreign parents of children born in Nicaragua, requiring the child's birth certificate in place of a marriage certificate, with the same other documentation and 5-year validity.
requirements.fix_path: Document parentage of a child born in Nicaragua and apply to DGME with the required documentation.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or child's Nicaraguan birth certificate

sources.title: Canal 4 Nicaragua (state-aligned broadcaster, reporting DGME's own published guidance) -- Residencia por Vinculo requirements, documentation, 5-year validity, USD 610 fee
